title: Chapter 362: Earth Dragon Beast Intrudes
content:
Chapter 362: Earth Dragon Beast Intrudes

In this situation, if no one can control the whole situation, a melee is inevitable.

At this time, the forces of the Treasure Pavilion of Yingying Town arrived.

Baichuan Zhonggu glanced at everyone, his eyes shining, his face showing disdain, and strode towards the platform.

Just as he was about to approach the platform, an arrow flew towards him.

"Brother Baichuan, the treasure is for everyone who sees it, but you are not allowed to take it all by yourself."

Baichuan Zhonggu casually slapped the arrow away and turned his head to see that it was Jiang Song and several top masters from Yingying Town who arrived.

He secretly regretted that if he had arrived earlier, he would have got the things at this time, and there would be nothing for them to do.

Now that several people have appeared, it is a bit tricky at this time.

But he will not give up easily. At this time, he is closest to the platform. No matter what, he will get the things first.

Zuo Da from the White Tiger Hall, Xi Wenhua from the Colosseum, and Jiang Song from the Songjiang Gang, all top generals, rushed over quickly, and even some high-level generals who were not afraid of death also approached with their heads held high.

But more people were self-aware and stayed where they were.

This kind of battle was not something they could participate in.

In order to prevent Baichuan Zhonggu from getting the treasure, several people approached quickly and used long-range attacks, and various darts and hidden weapons were fired continuously.

Baichuan Zhonggu had to turn around to deal with it.

After a few breaths, several people confronted each other again around the high platform.

In front of the treasure, there is no human relationship, even brothers are not necessarily reliable.

"You... I found this thing first."

"The treasures of heaven and earth belong to those with virtue. Baichuan Zhonggu, you don't know 'conquering people with virtue', right?"

"Don't think I'm afraid of you. Let's conquer people with virtue!"

Baichuan Zhonggu looked at the few people who surrounded him and looked for a way to break the deadlock.

At this moment, the ground suddenly shook.

Like an earthquake.

In a passage in the distance, a large number of monsters were pouring in, and some huge ones were stuck in the passage. Their huge bodies struggled hard, causing the whole hall to shake slightly.

Monsters don't learn from humans and talk about conquering people with virtue. They prefer to negotiate with teeth and claws.

For a while, humans and monsters fought.

The huge monster had countless sharp spikes on its body, emitting a metallic light.

Each spike was like a cone, covering its whole body.

At this time, someone exclaimed "Earth Dragon Beast".

The Earth Dragon Beast looks like a short-legged dinosaur.

He broke through the entire passage in a few moves and rushed to the platform desperately.

It seemed that the things on the platform were also very important to him.

"Human, step down, the treasure is mine."

Wang Shuo checked and found that this earth dragon beast was obviously a dark gold-level boss, and its strength was probably more powerful than that of ordinary top-level generals.

The five people who were originally confronting each other ignored the earth dragon beast and reached out to grab the light ball.

But they grabbed nothing.

The light ball seemed to be non-existent.

Just when several people were in doubt, the earth dragon beast had already killed, and several people had to join forces to deal with the boss.

In the passage, there were still a steady stream of monsters rushing in.

Wang Shuo was also targeted by a gold-level earth dragon beast.

The monsters that rushed in this time were basically boss-level, and the lowest level was silver boss, with a number of about 50.

But it was obvious that humans still had the upper hand, but humans were not a monolithic entity.

Even some hostile forces are attacking humans from behind.
